description.value:
Trigger Two areas of hazardous ground you created come within 15 feet of each other.

Two fires in the same building are not two fires for very long.

They reach for each other. The gap between the two areas becomes hazardous ground of the same type, and the whole connected mass counts as a single area for every other Foul Iron feat. A creature caught in the gap when it closes takes the persistent damage immediately.

cinderfall.incomplete: ---. This effect is defined entirely in terms of a Cinderfall-homebrew subsystem with zero Foundry schema footprint (the Gun Failure Table/Failure Range, hazardous ground, time-in-sights, Trick Iron charge bank, or Drift/augment-slot cost). Confirmed via the full rule-element type listing (pf2e-source/src/module/rules/rule-element/, 40 files): no RollTable-manipulation, no persistent-terrain-hazard, and no arbitrary stacking-counter rule element type exists to hook any of these to. This is a cross-creature effect: it changes a DIFFERENT creature's own roll, HP, condition, healing, or item from the actor's own passive or activated ability, with no companion linked Effect item in this corpus to carry it (unlike the six real *-effect cards this class does have). No selector exists for this anywhere in pf2e-source.
